jobs.title: Specialist, Operational Risk Management
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Objective
We are a leading technology hub in Guangzhou, dedicated to innovation and excellence in the tech industry. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated risk manager role with focus mainly on operational risk to strengthen DTC’s overall risk control resiliency. This role is pivotal in establishing, maintaining, and enhancing DTC’s operational risk framework, as well as ensuring stringent compliance with internal policies, processes and external regulations and providing continuous guidance and support to BU/SU on Risk/ LCS subjects.
Principal Responsibilities
Assist in establishing, maintaining, and enhancing DTC’s operational risk framework, including but not limited to:
Responsible for implementation of corporate operational risk PSG within the unit.
Responsible for development and implementation of unit-specific operational risk PSG and procedures.
Review proposed deviations from corporate and unit-specific operational risk policies and standards and residual risk rating.
Analyse and identify emerging trends and potential operational risks, including tracking and management reporting, e.g. Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicator (KRI), pre-audit assessment.
Run regular unit risk forum and attend group-level risk forum where required.
Oversee Business Continuity Management (BCM) and incident management.
Manage operational risk initiatives and target reviews.
Proactive in forging effective engagement with key stakeholders on overall risk management and governance matters.
Design and implement operational risk measures as part of DTC’s operational risk monitoring process.
Review and update relevant policies/ standards/ procedures.
Promote staff awareness, follow and track compulsory trainings and consequence management.
Other risk management related work as assigned by manager.
This role would also provide certain support to LCS (Legal, Compliance & Secretariat) function where needed, including but not limited to:
Identify, advise and manage legal/ regulatory risks associated with the operation of business and other related matters.
Update relevant policies/ standards/ procedures/ documentations where needed.
Other LCS related work as assigned by manager.
Education And Relevant Experience
Full-time bachelor degree holder (with law or risk management related major being a plus); master degree is preferred.
Minimum 8-year experience in legal/ compliance or risk management domain.
Demonstrated hands-on experience in identifying, assessing, treating, monitoring, reporting, and advising on corporate risk management.
Excellent organizational, problem solving, interpersonal and operating skills to independently and effectively drive tasks.
Experience in technology industry is an advantage.
Functional / Technical Competencies
Strong written and oral communication skills (in both English and Chinese), analytical and solution-oriented.
Profound knowledge of operational risk management requirements of China, in particular those applicable to IT business.
Knowledge and experience in technology company operational risk management practice is an advantage.
Strong ability to prioritize, self-motivated, independent and able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Willing to learn and take new challenges with an open-mind.
Good inter-personal skills, good commercial sense and a team player.

Job Objective
Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we digitalise majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.
We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on technology leader to drive the next generation of digital banking capabilities across customer onboarding, relationship management, workflow automation, data intelligence and Agentic AI platforms.
The role requires a leader who is equally comfortable engaging senior business stakeholders, defining technology architecture, managing engineering delivery, and coaching high-performing teams.
Principal Responsibilities
Technology Leadership
Lead the architecture, design and delivery of strategic digital banking platforms supporting customer acquisition, account opening, servicing, workflow automation and relationship management.
Define and execute technology roadmaps covering Generative AI, Agentic AI, advanced analytics, big data and intelligent automation capabilities.
Drive modern engineering practices, platform modernization and cloud-native architecture adoption.
Establish technical standards, governance frameworks and engineering best practices across the portfolio.
AI, Data & Analytics
Lead the design and implementation of GenAI and Agentic AI solutions to improve customer experience, operational efficiency and employee productivity.
Drive adoption of enterprise AI platforms, knowledge management solutions, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration frameworks and conversational AI capabilities.
Build and scale data-driven capabilities leveraging big data platforms, advanced analytics, machine learning and decision intelligence.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-impact AI and analytics use cases.
Delivery & Engineering Management
Lead multiple engineering squads across distributed locations and functions.
Manage engineering leads, developers, data engineers and platform specialists.
Own delivery outcomes including scope, quality, stability, security, scalability and operational performance.
Drive Agile and DevSecOps practices, ensuring timely and predictable delivery of strategic initiatives.
Business & Stakeholder Engagement
Partner closely with business, operations, product, architecture, risk and compliance teams.
Translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable technology solutions.
Communicate effectively with senior management, steering committees and executive stakeholders.
Manage delivery in a matrix organisation involving multiple departments, countries and vendor partners.
People Leadership
Recruit, develop and retain high-performing technology talent.
Provide coaching, mentorship and career development for engineering managers and technical specialists.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Experience
Education and Relevant Experience
Minimum 10 years of relevant technology experience, with significant experience in banking or financial services.
Proven experience managing engineering teams and delivering large-scale enterprise platforms.
Demonstrated experience operating in multinational organisations with matrix reporting structures.
Track record of delivering mission-critical customer-facing platforms and digital transformation programmes.
Exposure to commercial, corporate, SME, wealth management or transaction banking platforms.
Experience evaluating and implementing emerging technology solutions.
Strong understanding of risk, security, data governance and regulatory requirements in financial institutions.
Experience leading AI transformation programmes within banking.
Demonstrated ability to influence technology strategy at senior leadership level.
Passion for innovation, continuous learning and talent development.
Domain Expertise
Strong experience in one or more of the following areas:
Generative AI and Agentic AI
Data Analytics and Business Intelligence
Big Data Platforms and Data Engineering
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Digital Customer Onboarding
Account Opening Platforms
Workflow and Business Process Management Systems
Customer Service and Case Management Platforms
Technical Capability
Deep knowledge and practical experience in:
Enterprise architecture and solution design
Distributed systems and microservices
APIs and event-driven architectures
Cloud platforms and container technologies
Data platforms, data lakes and analytics ecosystems
AI/ML platforms and GenAI deployments
System integration and enterprise workflow orchestration
Software engineering lifecycle, DevSecOps and CI/CD practices
Leadership & Communication
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to lead through complexity in a matrix environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience working with teams across multiple geographies and cultures.
Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin, with the ability to engage effectively with regional stakeholders, business partners and technology teams.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Relevant certifications in cloud, data, AI, architecture or Agile delivery would be advantageous.

职位目标：
客户经理负责 开拓新客户，为客户推荐全方位的银行和个人理财产品，向客户提供优质的服务及专业指导并满足客户在个人理财方面的需求，以达到银行预期的业务目标。

销售银行产品和服务
1) 通过交叉销售、客户推荐、主动升級销售、个人业务关系等方式，获得新客户和拓展新的业务。
2) 通过审慎的财务需求分析/规划确认现有/预期客户的财务需求，推销已获得该城市监管主体许可的存款和理财产品。
3) 将产品及其可能存在的各种风险介绍给客户。
4) 参加各种销售和推广活动（例如实地推广、公司推销活动、路演等），以扩展客户基础和业务网络，在该城市推广银行的形象/品牌。
5) 向 丰盛理财中心经理 反映客户反馈和竞争情况并提出建议。
建立关系和个人账户服务
1) 与现有客户保持定期联络，以加强关系，减少客户流失。
2) 为客户提供最新的产品/市场信息及其账户状况，以增加账户 使 用 率 和产品渗透率。
3) 为客户开设账户，完成申请和相关文档。
4) 处理客户的 查 询。
5) 了解最新的产品/市场知识和财务需求分析/规划技能，在与客户交流时展现出高水平的专业能力。
客户体验管理
1) 按照银行要求的服务标准为客户提供最优质的服务。
2) 处理和跟进客户的要求和查询，以确保客户满意度。
教育背景和相关工作经验要求：
拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑；
普通话必须流利；
对当地银行惯例和规定具有良好的理解。
工作经验：
至少拥有在中国财务市场上的 3 年的销售经验。
资质：
拥有基金从业资格证
专业技能要求：
1. 产品和财务知识:
有关银行的产品和服务的知识
财务规划和分析知识、信用评估和分析知识
2. 市场和行业知识: 一般行业中的市场趋势和竞争活动知识、了解当地和海外市场、理解个人银行业的竞争及对其产生的作用、影响和机遇
3. 有效销售: 与客户和潜在客户建立现有关系，影响客户和潜在客户接受个人银行服务；试探和确认真实的需求，确定适当的解决方案以满足这些需求，成功地结束促成销售，全程跟进，防止“认知失调”。
4. 多重任务: 能够驾驭多个优先事务，保持敏锐的关注和精力水平，管理时间，使用移动技术高效地获得积极的成果。
5. 业绩表现: 通过拓展业务渠道和网络，按时按量按质完 不时核定而分配到其个人的各项销售任务。

Industry Tenure: Minimum of 3 years of progressive corporate or institutional relationship banking experience within the Financial Institutions sector.

Result-Driven: Unyielding focus on hitting commercial metrics while maintaining quality parameters.

Collaboration & Teamwork: Exceptional interpersonal skills designed to interface successfully across global matrixed networks.

Advanced portfolio credit risk evaluation and quantitative structuring skills.

Job Objective
DBS Bank is a leading financial services group in Asia, committed to leveraging technology to redefine banking. The DBS Technology Centre (DTC) is the Group's AI-powered technology hub, playing a crucial role in advancing DBS's AI capabilities and integrating AI deeply into the entire value chain of banking operations and services. DTC aims to strengthen core technological capabilities and empower technology with AI to enhance business resilience and strategic competitiveness across all core markets, working collaboratively with Group Technology to achieve the vision of becoming the "Best AI-Enabled Bank with a Heart".
The AI Tech Head (Future Ready / Applied AI) role within DTC will be a visionary leader responsible for spearheading the implementation and evolution of future-proof technological platforms and innovations. This role is critical in driving the "Future Ready Technology" mandate, which focuses on ensuring reliable and resilient platforms, fostering innovation and collaboration, and continuously experimenting with external partners to deliver exponential customer and employee experiences. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in injecting innovation across product and service development within and across platforms, particularly in areas leveraging AI, to align with DTC's strategic objectives.
Principal Responsibilities
Applied AI & Agentic AI Strategy Implementation:
Lead the development and execution of the technology strategy for Future Ready Technology within DTC, aligning with the overall Group Technology Mandate and DTC's AI-driven vision.
Lead the departmental Applied AI strategy planning and execution, focusing on the practical application and scaled implementation of AI in banking operations, rather than foundational model research and development.
Apply large model capabilities to core business and internal efficiency scenarios, continuously creating business and operational value through Agentic AI, Workflow Automation, voice, and collaborative intelligence.
Champion the continuous injection of innovation in product and service development, both within and across platforms, with a strong focus on AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
Continuously explore and leverage external partnerships to provide exponential customer experiences.
Agentic AI platform and framework development
Ensure the stability, scalability, and security of technology platforms within the Future Ready Technology domain.
Drive technological synergy and optimization through stronger collaboration among different platforms.
Focus on leveraging innovation and future-of-work technology to improve both customer and employee journeys.
Responsible for the technical direction and implementation of the AI Agent platform and development system, including AI development IDEs (e.g., Claude Code) and frameworks such as DIFY, Google ADK, LangChain/LangGraph, and Claude Agent SDK.
Drive the implementation of AI-driven process automation and digital workflow systems.
AI Security, Observability & Governance
Design and implement enterprise-level AI security architecture, including Agent Identity, OAuth, permissions management, and data access control.
Establish AI system observability, traceability, and evaluation mechanisms to ensure stability, security, and audit compliance.
Lead AI governance and risk management initiatives.
Future of Work & Collaborative Intelligence
Promote the integration of AI with collaboration tools like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace to drive transformation in future work styles.
Responsible for voice-related AI technical directions (STT/TTS, Image Processing, Video Generation, etc.).
Team Leadership and Cross-Regional Collaboration
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of technology professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
Lead a technology team and work closely with the Singapore team.
Promote knowledge sharing and best practices within DTC and across Group Technology.
Education And Relevant Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in technology leadership roles within the relevant industry, with a strong focus on innovation, platform development, and emerging technologies.
Familiarity with Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, and Workflow Design.
Experience with Applied AI and enterprise-level systems.
Proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex technology initiatives, particularly in areas related to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and future-ready platforms.
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate large teams.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, capable of engaging with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. English as a working language is required.
Strategic thinker with a proactive and innovative mindset.

jobs.descriptionText:
丰盛理财中心经理负责协助支行行长领导和管理分支机构客户经理团队，通过开发新客户和销售个人银行产品（存款和理财产品）及新客户来源渠道管理，达成所分配的业务目标。
审计和合规监控 1. 协助支行行长通过领导、教育、现有监控和有效的补救措施，提高销售过程的控制和合规质量。 2. 确保完全符合内部政策、标准、准则和规程及由当地监管机构做出的规范和法规，尤其是适用于开立新账户、贷款申请、批准和归档过程的规范和法规。
销售和客户体验管理 1. 协助支行行长领导和推动以个人和团队为基础的销售业绩，以达成所分配的各种个人银行产品的业务量目标。 2. 通过为现有的和新的客户提供优质的客户服务，管理和促进支行组合产品业绩的增长。 3. 确保销售规划和活动得以适当地执行，以优化销售能力和效率。 4. 对客户的特别要求做出快速的回应。 5. 向支行行长反映客户反馈和市场竞争情况，并提出有关销售战略、策略性促销活动等方面的建议。
对新客户来源的渠道管理 1. 建立和扩展业务渠道和网络，以探索新的业务机遇。 2. 加深与合作渠道的工作关系。
人才管理和开发 1. 在产品/市场和销售技能方面培训发展和指导客户经理团队，以提高他们在与客户交流期间的专业能力。 2. 督导分支机构客户经理团队的日常工作表现并维持员工纪律。 3. 与员工保持明确和即时的沟通，提供激励和支持，以鼓励他们达成指标。 4. 建立团队成员中的信任和士气，公平地处理员工问题。
丰盛理财中心经理将领导客户经理团队，直接向支行行长汇报，对个人和团队销售相关的目标负责。

拥有专业学位，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑。
至少5年相关工作经验。
具有管理领导下属的经验。
普通话必须流利。
必须符合当地有关在中国销售监管产品的规定。
产品知识 1. 展现出对银行产品和服务的充分理解。对财务知识具有良好的理解。
市场和行业知识 1. 了解金融行业的市场趋势和竞争活动。
人脉 1. 在组织内部和外部建立和维持人脉来促进业务增长。
关注增长 1. 不断地寻找新的业务机会并以增长为导向，并将其融入到各种业务活动之中。

主要职责
在分支机构设立阶段
与相关内部部门进行紧密的合作，跟进分支机构设立、外勤和内勤支持的资源规划和招聘方面等问题。
与个人银行支行运营部、合规部、风险管理部和审计部合作制作分支机构运营手册。
协助星展中国分公司和金融犯罪防范及企业安保的相应负责人，共同合作获得营业场所的第三方认证（防火认证、电脑安全认证和PBOC财务机构安全认证）。
业务展开
审计和合规监控
确保完全符合内部政策、标准、准则和规程（尤其是当地分支机构的运营规程）及由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定。
领导、教育员工，通过实时监控和有效的补救措施提高分支机构运营的控制和合规质量。
配合审计、合规以及相关监管部门对于支行的审计或者检查。
与总部Operation Management Office合作，对于审计以及合规检查中发现的相关问题进行整改，并对整改的结果进行及时的汇报。
根据公司规定，对于发现的各项合规问题，及时上报。
销售管理和业务开发
领导和推动以团队为基础的销售业绩，以达成分配给分支机构的整体销售目标。
制定销售战略和业务计划，并根据总部的相关策略进行战略的调整。
对各项销售指标进行监控，以及对于销售团队的提出相关的保持或者改进方法。
高效地利用分支机构的销售资源，根据销售人员的技能差距来分配销售目标，以提高生产力。
保持业务和社会联络，以促进业务推广、提高渗透率和扩展客户基础。
向分行行长及个人银行业务区域总监反映客户反馈和竞争情况并提出建议。
人才管理和开发
通过有效的招聘、资源规划和人力调度来确保充分的员工配备，以优化日常销售和运营生产力。
高效管理团队，保证团队的稳定性。根据各项表现，以及总部career roadmap或者考评要求，培养优秀的团队人员。
分辨员工的能力差距和缺点，推荐培训发展计划并跟踪培训后改进情况。
督导员工的日常工作表现并维持员工纪律。
与员工保持明确和即时沟通，提供激励和支持，以鼓励他们达成指标。
建立团队成员相互信任的氛围，提高士气，公平地处理员工问题。
客户体验管理
达到在多个客户满意度调查/跟踪计划中（例如神秘顾客和电话服务调查）的预设满意度水平。
督导员工的日常服务质量和分支机构的环境，达到符合银行要求的标准。
对客户的特别要求提供快速的回应，确保客户的口头和书面投诉可以按照内部准则得到及时地处理和解决。
保证销售团队和服务团队能够在日常工作中保持一定的服务质量，满足客人的合理请求。
积极配合总部各项客户体验管理项目，就支行层面提出相关的意见或建议。
对于重要的投诉，做到及时上报。并与CE team合作进行投诉处理与解决。
职责管辖范畴
支行行长/分行营业部负责人将领导分支机构所有员工，实线向个人银行业务区域总监或个人银行业务分区总监汇报，并同时实线向星展（中国）分行行长汇报，对指派分支机构相关的业务指标负责。
教育背景和相关工作经验要求
教育经历
良好的教育背景，拥有大学学历者优先考虑；
必须符合当地有关在中国销售监管产品的规定；
良好掌握英语和中文，普通话必须流利；
熟悉当地监管主体的规定。
工作经验
至少拥有在个人银行执行职级的7年以上工作经验，包括至少在销售管理上拥有5年以上工作经验，在分支机构运营领域拥有3年以上工作经验者优先考虑。
拥有管理下属的工作经验优先考虑。

Job Objective
职位目标
Work with Relationship Managers to drive new-to-product client acquisition from existing clients and new-to-bank prospects to achieve sales targets, and to defend & grow GTS revenue of key customers via cross-selling/upselling endeavors and best-in-class customer services. GTS uses a consultative selling model, within which GTS Sales and Solutioning manager completes client need analyses and recommendations to effectively engage clients and prospects and thereby provide appropriate cash management and trade finance solutions.
与客户经理团队合作，为现有和潜在客户提供GTS产品方案实现销售目标，同时通过交叉销售和升级销售以及出色的客户服务来使得现有重点客户的GTS收入稳定增长。GTS的企业销售和方案经理会采用顾问式的营销模式，充分了解客户需求以制定推荐方案，并保持与客户的密切沟通，从而提供最合适的现金管理和贸易融资方案。

与相对应的客户经理积极合作准备账户计划书并共同建立客户目标。

与客户经理、产品经理、实施经理、科技与营运部及其他相关部门合作提供客户的解决方案。

与相关部门和产品经理合作积极探寻市场的需求和机会所在并且把机会转变为业务需求。

Identifying cross-sell opportunities
Driving cash balance growth and trade facility utilization
Providing advisory support on product updates and market trends
Serving as single point of contact to manage GTS related query and service escalations

寻找交叉销售机会
致力于增长存款与贸易额度使用率
提供产品更新与市场动向的顾问支持
作为GTS对客的单一窗口统一协调相关客户咨询与服务

Develop a sufficient strong pipeline to meet revenue targets, with a wide range of deals covering every stage of the sales cycle.

通过有效的销售策略加快潜在交易转化为成功交易的速度，从而迅速增长利润。
Gain the respect and trust of community and network as a professional sales manager to generate referrals and new leads.
在社群和人际网络中建立专业的销售经理形象并且获得尊重和信任，以得到更多的新客户和业务机会的推介。

和其他业务部门共同为客户构架现金管理和贸易融资解决方案以获得更大的客户份额，积极为中国的企业客户销售交易服务部的产品和服务。

Credit experience/knowledge will be a plus 有信贷方面的经验或知识会是加分项

专业技能要求

Strong team player with good communication and interpersonal skills具有较强的团队合作精神，良好的沟通和人际交往能力

- 对外资银行工作抱有热忱

有相关销售经验和 客户开发经验者优先

Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. jobs.descriptionText:
Role Overview
We are seeking a high-killed Senior Test Engineer to join our global financial markets technology team. As part of a leading bank, you will ensure the integrity of our mission-critical, high-frequency, low-latency trading platforms. You will go beyond traditional testing by integrating AI-driven methodologies, Product Security, and rigorous Regulatory Compliance into the automation lifecycle to maintain our competitive edge in the global markets.
Key Responsibilities
Test Engineering: Design and scale sophisticated test suites and use Serenity BDD to automatically validate complex FX workflows (Spot, Forwards, Swaps).
Low-Latency Performance Validation: Execute rigorous testing for High-Frequency Trading (HFT) components, focusing on microsecond-level latency, jitter analysis, and system throughput.
AI-Enhanced Quality Engineering: Proactively leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM-based agents) to optimize test case generation, automate synthetic market data creation, and perform predictive defect analysis.
Product Security Integration: Conduct API vulnerability assessments and chaos testing to ensure trading infrastructure resilience.
Compliance & Data Governance: Ensure all testing activities—especially those involving AI tools—strictly adhere to banking regulations.
CI/CD & DevOps: Own the integration of automated suites into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid, secure, and compliant feedback loops for development teams.
Global Stakeholder Management: Partner with Traders, Quants, and Risk Managers across global offices to resolve complex production issues.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Professional Experience: Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation.
Technical Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in Java and the Serenity BDD framework.
Strong experience with Selenium, Cucumber, and REST-assured.
Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of FX products and market microstructure.
Proven experience testing High-Frequency / Low-Latency trading systems and the FIX Protocol.
Security & AI Competency: Experience in Product Security Testing and vulnerability identification. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to enhance the SDLC while maintaining data privacy standards.
Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with data privacy laws and financial compliance requirements related to cross-border data transfer and automated decision-making.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or a related field.
Preferred Attributes
"Security-First" and "AI-First" mindset in software quality assurance. Experience with high-volume time-series data analysis. Excellent communication skills for a multicultural, global banking environment.
